## The suffering

What do other languages do here, and who does it hurt? "I prefer it" is a preference. A commandment removes a wound.

## The rule, in one sentence

If it needs a paragraph, it is two rules or none.

## The verdict

Obvious, Sensible, Correct, Overdue, or Necessary. Be honest. Most things are Sensible.

## The snippet

It has to parse, check with zero errors, and run. The test suite enforces this for every card.

## What it costs

Every rule rejects some program somebody wanted to write. Name that program and explain why they are better off.
